sql: SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.props,'$.archetype.person_id')) AS SIGNED),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.props,'$.archetype.firstName')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.props,'$.archetype.lastName')) FROM (SELECT e.dst id FROM anchors e WHERE e.src=? AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows' UNION ALL SELECT e.src id FROM anchors e WHERE e.dst=? AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows') f JOIN anchors p ON p.id=f.id AND p.kind='NodeAnchor' AND p.arch_type='Person' ORDER BY CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.props,'$.archetype.person_id')) AS SIGNED)
